key_insight: MedPAO-VL replaces one-shot radiology report generation with an explainable, iterative agent that plans, checks, and self-corrects to better match chest X-ray findings and reporting protocols.
clinical_relevance: This could make automated chest X-ray reporting more trustworthy, structured, and clinically usable by reducing hallucinations and improving adherence to radiology formatting standards.
method: Uses a multimodal plan-act-observe loop for report generation
Adds an explainable vision module to capture diagnostic uncertainty
Refines output by comparing semantic discrepancies and correcting mismatches
evidence_signal: In the abstract, the system reports an expert-rated accuracy score of 3.5/5 and a structural score of 4.3/5, suggesting improved correctness and report organization.
watch_item: Clinical deployment may still require careful validation because expert-rated performance is promising but not yet proof of robust real-world safety across diverse imaging cases.
paper_title: MedPAO-VL: Interpretable and Protocol-Compliant Agent for Structured Radiology Report Generation
